automaticDomainAssignment: A production create may update aliases. Maintenance must cover all aliases before dispatch and remain effective afterward. No CLI skip-domain claim is made for this MCP operation.
finalArtifactAcceptance: After build: actual Git commit, version.json, deployment/configuration/environment metadata, browser behavior, routes and safety headers. Any mismatch stays contained.
projectEnvironmentValues: Preserve sealed production project inputs; no decryption or replacement of journey/CDN/Maps/analytics/title/logo values. The reviewed build command overrides only declared public origin/version/mock settings.
providerSettingLimit: MCP projection omits effective build/install/output and automatic Git-deploy configuration. Apply explicit reviewed build settings only within authorized release scope, verify their actual effect and preserve existing automatic deployment holds.
projectSettingPersistence: Explicit projectSettings may persist to following deployments. Record their effective result; any future release must rebind exact source/BUILD_SHA. No claim of deployment-only settings is made.
githubSourceSchemaVerified: Provider OpenAPI admits numeric/string repoId plus ref and sha for GitHub. Use explicit sha with main branch context; withLatestCommit=false.
